route: 1 (per-item published statistics: per-pair chi2 and Table 1 percentages by condition)
evidence: verify_sun_2016_risky_choice_graph.R (live irw_fetch, 756 rows, 189 ids; cov_graph_condition 1/2 = 95/94 persons = paper's N=95 probability-compressed / N=94 money-compressed). Route 1: paper Results report per-pair Pearson chi2(1,189) for condition x choice = 2.760, 6.484, 4.825, 9.029 (pairs 1-4); live uncorrected chi2 for resulta..resultd = 2.760, 6.484, 4.825, 9.029 (max |diff| 0.0004), and the nearest wrong pair is 1.7 away (resultb vs pair 3), so every item code matches exactly one pair and no other -- this distinguishes all 4 items from each other. Option axis: % resp=1 by condition 62.1/73.4, 41.1/59.6, 54.7/70.2, 44.2/66.0 vs Table 1 % probability bet 62/73, 41/60, 55/70, 44/68 (mean |dev| 0.46 as coded vs 25 if flipped), pinning resp 1 = option A = probability bet. The one 2-point miss (pair 4, money-compressed, 66.0 vs printed 68) is a paper misprint: 9.029 reproduces only from 62/94, while 64/94 would give 11.0. NOT established: what the graphs for pairs 2-4 looked like or their captions (unpublished; item_text blank).

route: 3 (published alpha + HTMT per named construct) + 5 (block structure)
evidence: verify_sun_2021_blockchain_loan_adoption.R (live table 4440 rows, 296 ids x 15 items). Route 3 (published scale statistics per NAMED construct): Cronbach's alpha, paper Table 2 vs live -- PR 0.968 vs 0.9683, RS 0.954 vs 0.9545, PF 0.956 vs 0.9558, COM 0.986 vs 0.9862, UI 0.980 vs 0.9801. HTMT, paper Table 3 vs live, all 10 first-order pairs -- PF-COM 0.096/0.0963, PR-COM 0.025/0.0247, RS-COM 0.161/0.1607, UI-COM 0.321/0.3211, PR-PF 0.297/0.2973, RS-PF 0.415/0.4152, UI-PF 0.236/0.2360, RS-PR 0.079/0.0788, UI-PR 0.119/0.1187, UI-RS 0.350/0.3497; max |diff| 0.0005 over 15 values. Swapping the closest pair (RS<->PF) would make RS-COM read 0.096 vs published 0.161, so every construct block is distinguished from every other. Route 5 corroborates: 15/15 items correlate most with their own prefix block (own-block mean r 0.86-0.96). Signs agree with Table 5 (PR->UI and COM->UI negative; construct-mean r -0.116 and -0.316). NOT established: order WITHIN a construct (pr1 vs pr2 vs pr3 etc.). Items within a block share polarity, have means within 0.07 (pr 5.01/5.06/5.08), and the published Table 2 outer loadings (e.g. PR1-3 0.901/0.887/0.865) do not reproduce (item-composite r 0.973/0.960/0.976), so within-block position rests only on the paper's explicit 1-3 numbering matching the column suffix. Hence PARTIAL.

route: 3 (published construct-level statistics: Table 7 HTMT matrix and Table 6 alpha, with a 720-way block-label permutation) + per-respondent join to the study's own mmc1.xlsx
evidence: verify_sun_2024_innovation.R, VERDICT: PASS. (A) live-to-deposit join on id==NO, 281/281 respondents, no NAs: live innovation1/2/3 agree with the mmc1.xlsx column of the same name on 100.0% and with the other two innovation columns on 72-80% (1v2 75, 1v3 80, 2v3 72). (B) paper Table 7 HTMT, all 15 cells recomputed from mmc1.xlsx under the processing script's block assignment: largest residual 0.0005 (INN-PV 0.558/0.5580, INN-PR 0.027/0.0274, INN-PE 0.446/0.4462, TTF-INN 0.353/0.3535, U-INN 0.343/0.3435); all 720 assignments of the six construct labels to the six blocks scored, identity best at 0.0005, next-best 0.0987, best with INN on a non-innovation block 0.1010. Table 6 INN alpha 0.961 vs 0.9608 observed. What this does NOT establish: the order of innovation1..3 within the INN block. HTMT, alpha, CR, AVE and the path statistics are all invariant to permuting the three items, and the only item-specific published figure (Table 6 bootstrap SD of the loading, 0.003/0.003/0.004) ties for two items and depends on resampling. Live means 5.32/5.31/5.38 have no published counterpart. The code-to-wording tie within the block rests on the paper's list numbers 1./2./3. matching the codes' digits. Construct membership pinned, within-block order not -> PARTIAL.

route 3-variant (published construct reliability) + code-derivation check; verify_sun_2024_performance_expectancy.R. (B) from the live items: alpha 0.981, PLS mode-A AVE 0.963, CR 0.987 vs paper Table 6 Performance expectation 0.981/0.963/0.987 (max|diff| 0.0005); nearest other constructs PV (0.967/0.984/0.983, max|diff| 0.0037) and TTF (0.0047), INN 0.0363, PR 0.0473, U 0.0113 -- pins the three live codes as the paper's Performance expectation block.
